title: EX130 RV1: EMA + CCI with Time-Bomb Cut-Loss
entry_long: EMA5 > EMA50 + CCI > 0; forward-mode (trailing-stop 15 pips after 2+ trades)
exit: trailing-stop 15 pips OR time-bomb velocity cut at 500 pips/10sec drop
buildon_idea: time-bomb cut-loss is velocity-based emergency; test with explicit SL ladder; forward/reverse mode split is buildable for multi-timeframe
novelty_note: adds velocity-based exit signal + forward/reverse mode toggle; improves over base EX130

title: RSI + Bollinger Band Scalping
entry_long: price crosses above lower band + RSI < 30 (oversold entry)
entry_short: price crosses below upper band + RSI > 70 (overbought entry)
exit: fixed-TP 5 USD or grid at 100 pips
buildon_idea: add SL at 3-bar extremum; test linear escalation instead of fixed; spread-stress test on different symbols
novelty_note: simple RSI+BB mean-reversion scalper; foundational; low novelty

title: RSI + Bollinger Band with Forward/Reverse Modes
entry_long: BB-Lower cross + RSI<30; forward-mode: follow trend with grid; reverse-mode: counter-trend on pullback
exit: trailing-stop 15 pips (when 2+ trades open) OR flat-lot test (close when profit > 10 pips total)
escalation_cap: uncapped in forward, log or flat in reverse variant
buildon_idea: split forward/reverse modes are strong; cap martingale at 8+ bars; replace fixed spread concerns with pending limit buy/sell; test flat-lot PF to validate edge
novelty_note: forward/reverse mode split + time-bomb exit = medium novelty; validates mean-reversion thesis

title: Time-Bomb Entry with Pending-Order Hedge
entry_long: velocity 100 pips/5sec up → open buy 0.02; place pending sell 0.01 at 50-pip offset
entry_short: velocity 100 pips/5sec down → open sell 0.02; place pending buy 0.01 at 50-pip offset
exit: SL 100 pips, TP 200 pips (both initial trade and hedge)
buildon_idea: hedging via pending orders is low-risk; test varying offset (50→75 pips) and lot sizes (0.02/0.01→0.01/0.01 flat); spread impact on pips?
novelty_note: velocity-triggered entry + pending hedge = medium-high novelty; reduces directional risk

title: Candlestick High-Volume Reversal with Martingale
entry_long: candle-body 500+ pips → price pulls back 100+ pips from high → buy signal at high
entry_short: candle-body 500+ pips → price pulls back 100+ pips from low → sell signal at low
exit: SL = 3-bar lowest/highest, TP = 200% of SL (1:2 RR)
escalation_cap: 2.0 lots limit (survives 8 consecutive losses, tested at ~12 max)
buildon_idea: high-volume candle filter is strong; test TP at 150%, 250% of SL; extend cap to 3-4 lots on different symbols; add equity-based stop-loss gate
novelty_note: candlestick morphology + pullback entry + martingale capped = good novelty; captures mean-reversion after extremes

title: Multi-Symbol Dashboard R2: 20 Pairs + Auto Group Control
